captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a hydraulic dropper seatpost for a bicycle. It features a black lower outer tube clamped at the top by a quick-release collar with a silver lever, and a gold-colored inner telescoping post. At the top of the inner post is a black dual-bolt saddle clamp holding two parallel silver cylindrical rails, representing the saddle mounting interface. The inner post slides vertically relative to the outer tube via a prismatic joint.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of an adjustable hydraulic dropper seatpost. The model should include a black lower body tube, a quick-release binder collar with a silver lever, a gold-colored inner telescoping tube that slides vertically, and a black two-bolt saddle rail clamp holding two parallel silver rails at the top.
captions.factory: Construct the lower post assembly using a cylinder for the main tube, a larger cylinder for the collar, and extruded sketches for the quick-release clamp ears and lever. Model the inner telescoping post as a cylinder with a gold material finish. Build the top clamp assembly using a box with cylindrical cuts for the saddle rails, and add cylindrical fasteners. Define a prismatic joint along the Z-axis connecting the lower post assembly to the inner telescoping post.
